Situation.Name: Teams learning together
Situation.Setting: A shared software workspace in a near-future city at dusk. Through the interior window at the left, another small team collaborates around a shared table and whiteboard in a connected office, softly out of focus.
Situation.Camera: Wide horizontal banner composition, eye-level medium-wide view. Three colleagues form an open triangle beside a glass planning board; protagonist on left. Keep faces and shared diagram in central area safe for 16:9 crop.

CharacterPose.Expression: Thoughtful and attentive, looking at a speaking colleague rather than the camera
CharacterPose.BodyPosition: Standing alongside two colleagues as an equal participant
CharacterPose.Gesture: Holding a marker loosely, pausing to listen

Article.Application: On a transparent board beside the group, kept visually secondary to faces

Article.Name: Collaborating background team
Article.Description: Three colleagues clustered around a shared worktable and modest whiteboard, discussing a change
Article.Application: Visible through the interior window at the far left, smaller and softly out of focus

Environment.Name: Neighbourhood light
Environment.Description: Restrained cyan and magenta city reflections with cool blue ambient light throughout both workspaces

KeyDetails: Three colleagues are engaged with one another, no lone heroic coder
The other colleagues are visually distinct from the recurring silver-haired protagonist
Human faces and listening gestures are the focal point
No robots, floating dashboards, logos, titles or readable text
Background is a collaborating software team, with no retail counter, parcels, service uniforms or warm yellow room
Situation.LightingFocus: Cool blue ambient light throughout the connected offices, with soft magenta rim light on silver curls. Background team receives subdued cyan light, keeping foreground faces the focal point.
